g.title: j422709773
g.text: Well, you should like the game, you kept beating me at it.

g.title: j2416400899
g.text: Don't feel too bad about losing all those games. I've had a *lot* of practice at komi.

g.title: j4161783295
g.text: Thanks for teaching me Lonestar Hold'Em

g.title: j4072808187
g.text: how's it going, convincing the team to play F&F?

g.title: j1197983047
g.text: i try to get them to play Fables & Frontiers with me, but they say it's too dorky

g.title: j3699929605
g.text: yeah well strategy games are kinda my jam, yo

g.title: j4126904028
g.text: eh hey y'know it beats 80-million games of Lonestar Hold'Em like i usually end up playing all week lol

g.title: j4054947673
g.text: They're just worried about all of the whole "end of the world" stuff.

g.title: j2247172041
g.text: RIGHT. SPACE. hahaha you've never heard of a TTRPG. it's a table top roleplaying game

g.title: j2436487189
g.text: yeah, but they gotta learn to unwind now and again, y'know? if we all just sit around brooding whats the point of still being alive?

g.title: j1679602435
g.text: Yeah, and I don't think I can convince any others, so we should just play now.

g.title: j2364752827
g.text: Yeah, but I think I can get more of them on board.

g.title: j2925214068
g.text: No, I'm still working on it. But I'll get there.

g.title: j987566707
g.text: where you and a bunch of friends sit around and make up characters and fight monsters by rolling dice and tell a story and it's SUPER FUN

g.title: j367182456
g.text: but the keywords there are "a bunch of friends" and if you don't have a few people to play with it's super lame

g.title: j860885445
g.text: oh well anyway thanks for playing games with me let's do it again soon

g.title: j2762187251
g.text: Aw, well, let's play more games with the two of us, then.

g.title: j2622069892
g.text: Maybe I can talk the Hex into playing. :)

g.title: j3412077737
g.text: I... owe a lot of favors...

g.title: j3670552724
g.text: I can't divulge my secrets. Then I'd have to kill you.

g.text: this might be the nicest thing anybody's ever done for me...

she's got the "voice" for it lolol
